title: A Study of Cardiac Safety in Patients With HER2 Positive Early Breast Cancer Treated With Herceptin
brief_summary: This is a single cohort observational safety study. All patients will be treated and monitored according to the local clinical practice. No additional procedures/patient visits in comparison with the usual clinical practice are planned for the study. Data will be collected from centre's medical records for up to 5 years or death.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients who are considered candidates to receive Herceptin for this indication

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients for whom Herceptin is contraindicated
